ASAS-SN describes Sky Patrol light curves as public and provides publication citations. CTAS may link an operator to the official HTTPS coordinate-query page. No automated provider-data request was sent. The official legacy HTTPS query form requires reCAPTCHA and says users needing more than 100 light curves should contact ASAS-SN. CTAS therefore withholds automatic ingestion until ASAS-SN publishes a current secure, bounded machine-access contract. This is an interface-integrity boundary, not a claim that the public light-curve data are proprietary.
